title: Punch-line cadence check
description:
As a copy editor, I want a very short sentence that lands right after a long one flagged when it closes a paragraph or recurs within one, so mic-drop rhythm is caught even when sentence lengths vary.

Feature: Punch-line cadence
  Scenario: Repeated drops in one paragraph are flagged
    Given a paragraph where two very short sentences each follow a long sentence
    When I diagnose it with the surface-rules profile
    Then diagnosis reports punch-line cadence findings for both short sentences
  Scenario: A short closing line after a long sentence is flagged
  Scenario: One mid-paragraph short sentence is not flagged
  Scenario: A profile can turn the check off

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Implemented punchlineCadence (kind punchline_cadence, voice_observations). Rules: <=6 words after >=14 closing a paragraph or twice in one; terse <=4-word closer after a sentence twice its length in a 3+ sentence paragraph. Skips headings, lists, tables, JSX, list lead-ins, questions, quotations, link-only CTAs, code fences. 7 scenarios green. Anth.us corpus sweep (71 articles/solutions): 87 hits before tuning, 73 after; sampled hits are genuine mic-drops. Provenance: claude-code / claude-opus-5-5.
